judged_text: Zoho bigin and zohocrm sharing path: tokenInfo.data.error on a fetch Response is undefined, causing a TypeError on refresh for both Zoho integrations when credential sharing is enabled

record.issue_text: Zoho bigin and zohocrm sharing path: tokenInfo.data.error on a fetch Response is undefined, causing a TypeError on refresh for both Zoho integrations when credential sharing is enabled

adjudication.rationale:
When credential sharing is enabled, `refreshOAuthTokens()` returns a `fetch` `Response` object (it does `return response;` from `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)`). In both Zoho integrations the callers still assume an axios-style response and access `.data`:
- `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`: `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`
- `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`: `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`
A `fetch` `Response` has no `.data`, so `tokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and `tokenInfo.data.error` will throw a TypeError at runtime on the sharing path. This defect is directly introduced by switching these flows to `refreshOAuthTokens()` without adapting the response handling.
